topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Well, now, this here’s a curious thing indeed. Found a chest in the ground, did ye? Not just any chest, but one filled with olden things, wrapped neat and tidy, as if keeping secrets from the eyes of the past. My, but what tales it must hold! I can picture the hands that placed it there, steady and sure, with the hopes and dreams of those who’ve gone before us. Such a find’s a gift, a way to touch the hands of those who once called this earth home. We tend the land, but sometimes, it’s the earth that tends to us, offering up these treasures to remind us of the kindred spirits that walked these fields. Care for that chest gentle-like, and see what stories it might whisper to you.
